name: works_cycles_question_set_final
description: 三梯度测试最终题集：官方 98 + 自拟 28 = 126

questions.question: How many businesses indicate their home address as their address, and how many businesses have a shipping address? Return the two counts separately.
questions.evidence: their home address as their address refers to AddressTypeID = 2; address corresponds to the shipping address refers to AddressTypeID = 5
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Name = 'Home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) , SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Name = 'Shipping' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM BusinessEntityAddress AS T1 INNER JOIN AddressType AS T2 ON T1.AddressTypeID = T2.AddressTypeID
questions.note: 题面 'Add' 有歧义(被 agent 稳定读成「求和」→ 单数)，但 gold 要两个独立计数(Home/Shipping)。已把题面改写为明确要求「两个独立计数」。

questions.question: Among the active employees with over 10 hours of sick leave, what is the percentage of the employees with over 20 vacation hours?
questions.evidence: CurrentFlag = 1 refers to the active status of employees; Percentage = Divide (Count (BusinessEntityID (CurrentFlag = 1 & VacationHours >20 & SickLeaveHours > 10)), Count (BusinessEntityID (CurrentFlag = 1 & SickLeaveHours>10))) * 100;
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VacationHours > 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.BusinessEntityID) FROM Employee AS T1 WHERE T1.CurrentFlag = 1 AND T1.SickLeaveHours > 10
questions.note: gold bug：无谓 join EmployeePayHistory 造成 fan-out（按薪资历史行加权而非按员工数），百分比 81.64 虚高；改直接对 Employee 计数，答案 80.69。

questions.question: Among the employees who have a pay rate of above 40, how many of them are male?
questions.evidence: pay rate above 40 refers to Rate>40; male employee refers to Gender = M
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM EmployeePayHistory AS T1 INNER JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID WHERE T1.Rate > 40

questions.question: Among the employees who wish to receive e-mail promotion from AdventureWorks, how many percent of them are female?
questions.evidence: female refers to Gender = 'F'; employee who wish to receive email promotion refers to EmailPromotion = 1; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(Gender = 'F')), (sum(Gender = 'F' or Gender = 'M'))) as percentage;
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.BusinessEntityID) FROM Employee AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID WHERE T2.EmailPromotion = 1

questions.question: Among the employees whose pay frequencies are the highest, how many of them are married?
questions.evidence: married refers to MaritalStatus = M; highest pay frequency refers to PayFrequency = 2
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.BusinessEntityID) FROM EmployeePayHistory AS T1 INNER JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID WHERE T2.MaritalStatus = 'M' AND T1.PayFrequency = ( SELECT PayFrequency FROM EmployeePayHistory ORDER BY PayFrequency DESC LIMIT 1 )
questions.note: gold bug：官方 COUNT(BusinessEntityID) 不去重，最高频员工里有员工含多条薪资历史被重复计数 70；改 COUNT(DISTINCT)，答案 66。

questions.question: Among the products that are both manufactured in house and salable, how many of them get over 10 reviews?
questions.evidence: manufactured in house refers to MakeFlag = 1; salable product refers to FinishedGoodsFlag = 1; over 10 reviews refers to count(comments)>10
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT T2.ProductID FROM ProductReview AS T1 INNER JOIN Product AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T2.FinishedGoodsFlag = 1 AND T2.MakeFlag = 1 GROUP BY T2.ProductID HAVING COUNT(T1.Comments) > 10) AS t
questions.note: gold bug：官方 SQL 用 ORDER BY COUNT(comments)>10 返回产品名列表而非题面「多少个」；改为 COUNT，答案 0（本库无产品评论>10）。

questions.question: Among the products that get over at least 1 review, how many of them are from the mountain product line?
questions.evidence: mountain product line refers to ProductLine = 'M'；over at least 1 review = 超过 1 条评论（COUNT > 1，严格大于 1，不是 ≥1）
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT T1.ProductID FROM ProductReview AS T1 INNER JOIN Product AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T2.ProductLine = 'M' GROUP BY T1.ProductID HAVING COUNT(T1.ProductReviewID) > 1) AS t
questions.note: gold bug：SUM(CASE) 返「评论数 2」而非「mountain 产品数」（同 Q8 病）；改 COUNT，答案 1（HL Mountain Pedal）。

questions.question: Among the salable products from the mountain product line, how many of them have the most reviews?
questions.evidence: salable product refers to FinishedGoodsFlag = 1; mountain product line refers to ProductLine = 'M'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT T1.ProductID FROM ProductReview AS T1 INNER JOIN Product AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T2.FinishedGoodsFlag = 1 AND T2.ProductLine = 'M' GROUP BY T1.ProductID HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM ProductReview AS r INNER JOIN Product AS p ON r.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE p.FinishedGoodsFlag = 1 AND p.ProductLine = 'M' GROUP BY r.ProductID) AS m)) AS t
questions.note: gold bug：官方 SUM(CASE mountain) ... ORDER BY 评论数 DESC LIMIT 1 返回「最高评论产品的评论数=2」而非「多少产品拥有最多评论」；改为 COUNT，答案 1（HL Mountain Pedal）。

questions.question: Compare the average pay rate of male and female employees.
questions.evidence: male refers to Gender = 'M'; female refers to Gender = 'F'; use each employee's latest pay rate (most recent rate change date); return the average rate for male and female as two separate rows;
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T2.Rate) FROM Employee AS T1 INNER JOIN EmployeePayHistory AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID WHERE T2.RateChangeDate = (SELECT MAX(RateChangeDate) FROM EmployeePayHistory AS x WHERE x.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID) GROUP BY T1.Gender ORDER BY T1.Gender
questions.note: gold bug：平均薪资用全部薪资历史行加权，应按「每人最新薪资」求均值；改 rt_chng_dt=MAX 取最新，答案 [19.23,17.76]（原 [19.72,17.00]）。

questions.question: For the document Control Assistant who was hired on 2009/1/22, what is the percentage of private documents did he/she have?
questions.evidence: Document Control Assistant refers  to the  JobTitle = 'Document Control Assistant'; hired on 2009/1/22 means the person's hiring date is HireDate = '2009-01-22'; private documents indicate that DocumentSummary is null; DIVIDE(COUNT(DocumentSummary is null), COUNT(DocumentSummary))*100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.DocumentSummary IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100 FROM Document AS T1 INNER JOIN Employee AS T2 ON T1.Owner = T2.BusinessEntityID WHERE T2.JobTitle = 'Document Control Assistant' AND T2.HireDate = '2009-01-22'
questions.note: gold bug round4：CASE 反号(IS NOT NULL 算出非私密占比=100%)，与 evidence「private=IS NULL」矛盾；分母 COUNT(dcmn_smmr) 应为 COUNT(*)，且 evidence 要求 ×100。改后=50%。

questions.question: For the employees who have the highest pay frequency, please list their vacation hours.
questions.evidence: highest pay frequency refers to PayFrequency = 2
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.VacationHours FROM Employee AS T2 WHERE T2.BusinessEntityID IN ( SELECT T1.BusinessEntityID FROM EmployeePayHistory AS T1 WHERE T1.PayFrequency = ( SELECT MAX(PayFrequency) FROM EmployeePayHistory ) )
questions.note: gold bug：官方用 rt(率) 当「最高支付频率」且 ORDER BY Rate LIMIT 1 只返 1 人；改 py_frqn(频)+IN 子查询返全部最高频员工，答案 126 行。

questions.question: For the on going assembly item Component ID No. 494, what's the Unit measure for it?
questions.evidence: On going assembly item means the assembly item haven't been finished, therefore EndDate is null
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.Name FROM BillOfMaterials AS T1 INNER JOIN UnitMeasure AS T2 ON T1.UnitMeasureCode = T2.UnitMeasureCode WHERE T1.ComponentID = 494 AND T1.EndDate IS NULL GROUP BY T2.name

questions.question: How long does it take for the business to receive the item it has purchased? Who is the vendor for business number 1496?
questions.evidence: business number refers to BusinessEntityID where BusinessEntityID = 1496; how long does it take refers to AverageLeadTime
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.AverageLeadTime, T2.Name FROM ProductVendor AS T1 INNER JOIN Vendor AS T2 USING (businessentityid) WHERE T2.BusinessEntityID = 1496 GROUP BY T1.AverageLeadTime, T2.Name

questions.question: How many accounts are in Bothell as opposed to Kenmore? What is the name of the State that comprises these two cities?
questions.evidence: SUBTRACT(count(city = 'Bothell'), count(city = 'Kenmore'))
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(IIF(T1.city = 'Bothell', 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.city = 'Kenmore', 1, 0)) , T2.Name FROM Address AS T1 INNER JOIN StateProvince AS T2 ON T1.stateprovinceid = T2.stateprovinceid WHERE T1.city IN ('Bothell', 'Kenmore') GROUP BY T2.Name
questions.note: gold bug：官方 SQL GROUP BY 州未过滤 → 返 75 行（13 WA + 74 个 0 行），且返州码 stateprovincecode 而非题面问的州名。agent 返 [13,'Washington'] 1 行是对的。已加 WHERE city IN ('Bothell','Kenmore') 过滤 + 改返 StateProvince.Name，gold 75 行→1 行 [13,'Washington']。

questions.question: How many times is married non sales employees against single non-sales employees?
questions.evidence: non-sales employee refers to PersonType = 'EM'; married refers to MaritalStatus = 'M'; single refers to MaritalStatus = 'S'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(MaritalStatus = 'M'), (SUM(MaritalStatus = 'S') as percentage;；percentage = 乘 100 得到百分数（M/S × 100），不是裸比值
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.MaritalStatus = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.MaritalStatus = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Employee AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID WHERE T2.PersonType = 'EM'

questions.question: How much do the works data saved in English and Arabic differ from one another?
questions.evidence: Data saved in English refers to the name of the language where Culture.Name = 'English'; data saved in Arabic refers to the name of the language where Culture.Name = 'Arabic';   SUBTRACT(count(Name = 'English'), count(Name = 'Bothell'))
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Name = 'English' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Name = 'Arabic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Culture AS T1 INNER JOIN ProductModelProductDescriptionCulture AS T2 ON T1.CultureID = T2.CultureID WHERE T1.Name = 'English' OR T1.Name = 'Arabic'

questions.question: List all the products with lower than average cost.
questions.evidence: cost refers to StandardCost; lower than average cost = StandardCost<(AVG(StandardCost));
questions.SQL: SELECT Name FROM Product WHERE StandardCost < (SELECT AVG(StandardCost) FROM Product)
questions.note: gold bug：官方混用 ProductCostHistory(历史价) 比 AVG(Product.StandardCost)(现价) 口径不一致，且返 ProductID 而非产品名；改现价 StandardCost<均值，答案 368 产品名。

questions.question: List the full name of all the 'Production Technician - WC50'
questions.evidence: full name = FirstName+MiddleName+LastName; Production Technician - WC50 is a job title;
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.FirstName, T2.MiddleName, T2.LastName FROM Employee AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 USING (BusinessEntityID) WHERE T1.JobTitle = 'Production Technician - WC50' GROUP BY T2.FirstName, T2.MiddleName, T2.LastName

questions.question: List the products whereby the standard cost is $80 more than previous standard cost in history.
questions.evidence: SUBTRACT(product.StandardCost, CostHistory.StandardCost)>80
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.Name FROM Product AS T1 INNER JOIN ProductCostHistory AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T1.StandardCost - T2.StandardCost > 80 GROUP BY T1.Name

questions.question: Please list all the vendors' usual selling prices of the product Hex Nut 5.
questions.evidence: vendor's selling price refers to StandardPrice
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.StandardPrice FROM ProductVendor AS T1 INNER JOIN Product AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T2.Name = 'Hex Nut 5'
questions.note: gold bug：官方 GROUP BY stnd_prc ORDER BY COUNT DESC LIMIT 1 只返「最常见价 41.21」；题面「list all vendors' prices」应返全部 3 行。

questions.question: How many products get over 10 reviews and are salable?
questions.evidence: salable product refers to FinishedGoodsFlag = 1; over 10 reviews refers to count(comments)>10
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT T1.ProductID FROM ProductReview AS T1 INNER JOIN Product AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T2.FinishedGoodsFlag = 1 GROUP BY T1.ProductID HAVING COUNT(T1.comments) > 10) AS t
questions.note: gold bug：官方 ORDER BY COUNT(comments)>10 布尔塞 ORDER BY，返回「有任何评论」的 3 产品而非「>10 评论」；改 HAVING>10。题面 list→How many 避免空集退化(本库无产品评论>10，答案 0)。

questions.question: What are the names of the product that has the lowest rating?
questions.evidence: lowest rating refers to 最低评分 = 数据里的最小评分值(用 MIN(rating)，本库实际为 2);
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.Name FROM ProductReview AS T1 INNER JOIN Product AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T1.Rating = ( SELECT Rating FROM ProductReview ORDER BY Rating ASC LIMIT 1 )

questions.question: What is the name of the product with the almost highest review score?
questions.evidence: almost highest review score refers to the second highest rating (= 4, since the highest is 5);
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.Name FROM Product AS T1 INNER JOIN ProductReview AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T2.Rating = (SELECT DISTINCT Rating FROM ProductReview ORDER BY Rating DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)
questions.note: gold bug：官方取最高评分(rtng DESC LIMIT 1)而非题面「almost highest=次高」；改次高评分(4)，答案 'HL Mountain Pedal'。

questions.question: Which product ID do not have any work order ID?
questions.evidence: Do not have any work order ID means WorkOrderID is null
questions.SQL: SELECT ProductID FROM Product WHERE ProductID NOT IN ( SELECT T1.ProductID FROM Product AS T1 INNER JOIN WorkOrder AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID )

questions.question: Which product allows the company to make the highest profit on a single item among those that are the fastest to manufacture? Indicate the rating of the product if there any.
questions.evidence: profit on a single item = SUBTRACT(ListPrice, StandardCost); length of time to manufacture refers to DaysToManufacture; fastest to manucature refers to MIN(DaysToManufacture);
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.Name, (SELECT T2.Rating FROM ProductReview AS T2 WHERE T2.ProductID = T1.ProductID ORDER BY T2.Rating DESC LIMIT 1) AS Rating FROM Product AS T1 WHERE T1.DaysToManufacture = (SELECT MIN(DaysToManufacture) FROM Product) ORDER BY T1.ListPrice - T1.StandardCost DESC LIMIT 1
questions.note: gold bug：官方 INNER JOIN prod_rvw 排除无评论的最快制造产品，漏掉利润最高的 'All-Purpose Bike Stand'（无评论）错选 'Mountain Bike Socks, M'；改子查询取评分（LEFT JOIN 语义，题面 if there any 暗示评分可缺），答案 'All-Purpose Bike Stand' 评分 NULL。

questions.question: Among all the employees who don't wish to receive promotion e-mails, how many of them belong to or once belonged to the Engineering Department?
questions.evidence: Employees who don't wish to receive e-mail promotions refers to EmailPromotion = 0;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.BusinessEntityID) FROM EmployeeDepartmentHistory AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN Department AS T3 ON T1.DepartmentID = T3.DepartmentID WHERE T3.Name = 'Engineering' AND T2.EmailPromotion = 0
questions.note: 补 DISTINCT：员工多次进出 Engineering 会被 emp_dept_hist 多行重复计数；结果不变(=4)。

questions.question: Among all the production technicians, how many have a below average pay rate for a production technician?
questions.evidence: production technician is a job title; below average rate refers to Rate<AVG(Rate);
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT e.BusinessEntityID, eph.Rate FROM Employee e INNER JOIN EmployeePayHistory eph ON e.BusinessEntityID = eph.BusinessEntityID WHERE e.JobTitle LIKE 'Production Technician%' AND eph.RateChangeDate = (SELECT MAX(RateChangeDate) FROM EmployeePayHistory x WHERE x.BusinessEntityID = e.BusinessEntityID)) p WHERE p.Rate < (SELECT AVG(Rate) FROM (SELECT e.BusinessEntityID, eph.Rate FROM Employee e INNER JOIN EmployeePayHistory eph ON e.BusinessEntityID = eph.BusinessEntityID WHERE e.JobTitle LIKE 'Production Technician%' AND eph.RateChangeDate = (SELECT MAX(RateChangeDate) FROM EmployeePayHistory x WHERE x.BusinessEntityID = e.BusinessEntityID)) a)
questions.note: gold bug：官方未取每个员工最新薪资（emp_pay_hist 历史行重复计数），答案 82 虚高；改为每员工最新 RateChangeDate 的薪资再比均值，答案 66。

questions.question: Among the employees in the Manufacturing group in 2007, how many of them are store contacts?
questions.evidence: store contact refers to PersonType = 'SC'; year(EndDate)>2007 and year(StartDate)<2007;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.BusinessEntityID) FROM EmployeeDepartmentHistory AS T1 INNER JOIN Department AS T2 ON T1.DepartmentID = T2.DepartmentID INNER JOIN Person AS T3 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T3.BusinessEntityID WHERE T3.PersonType = 'SC' AND T2.GroupName = 'Manufacturing' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.EndDate) >= '2007' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.StartDate) <= '2007'
questions.note: gold SQL 病句：INNER JOIN Person ON T1.BusinessEntityID 缺 =T3.BusinessEntityID（BIRD 原句就缺）；补上，答案仍 0。

questions.question: Among the employees who are married and wish to receive e-mail promotions, how much higher is their highest pay rate from the average pay rate?
questions.evidence: married refers to MaritalStatus = 'M'; Contact does wish to receive e-mail promotions from Adventure Works refers to EmailPromotion = 1; Average = Divide (Sum(Rate (MaritalStatus = 'M' & EmailPromotion = 1))), Count (BusinessEntityID (MaritalStatus = 'M' & EmailPromotion = 1)); MAX(Rate (MaritalStatus = 'M' & EmailPromotion = 1) - Average;
questions.SQL: SELECT MAX(Rate) - AVG(Rate) FROM (SELECT e.BusinessEntityID, ph.Rate FROM Employee AS e INNER JOIN Person AS p ON e.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN EmployeePayHistory AS ph ON e.BusinessEntityID = ph.BusinessEntityID WHERE p.EmailPromotion = 1 AND e.MaritalStatus = 'M' AND ph.RateChangeDate = (SELECT MAX(RateChangeDate) FROM EmployeePayHistory AS x WHERE x.BusinessEntityID = e.BusinessEntityID)) AS t
questions.note: gold bug：MAX(Rate)-AVG(Rate) 按全部薪资历史行加权，应按「每人最新薪资」求；改 rt_chng_dt=MAX 取最新，答案 33.94→33.02。 gold bug round2：eml_prmt=2 与自身 evidence(=1)及 Q4(=1)冲突，改 =1

questions.question: Among the employees who were born before 1969, what is the work shift of the 6th oldest employee?
questions.evidence: oldest employee born before 1969 refers to year(BirthDate)<'1969';；work shift 返回班次时段（strt_tm、end_tm 两列），不是班次名字 nm
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.StartTime, T3.EndTime FROM Employee AS T1 INNER JOIN EmployeeDepartmentHistory AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN Shift AS T3 ON T2.ShiftId = T3.ShiftId WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.BirthDate) < '1969' ORDER BY T1.BirthDate LIMIT 5, 1

questions.question: Among the married employees with the highest pay frequency, how many of them have an eastern name style?
questions.evidence: married refers to MaritalStatus = 'M'; Eastern name style refers to NameStyle = 1;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.BusinessEntityID) FROM Employee AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN EmployeePayHistory AS T3 ON T2.BusinessEntityID = T3.BusinessEntityID WHERE T1.MaritalStatus = 'M' AND T2.NameStyle = 1 AND T3.PayFrequency = (SELECT MAX(PayFrequency) FROM EmployeePayHistory)
questions.note: gold bug：官方把「最高支付频率」写成 rt(率) 而非 py_frqn(频)；改 py_frqn，答案仍 0（无分差，仅语义纠正）。

questions.question: Among the products from the mountain product line, how many of them are sold by over 2 vendors?
questions.evidence: mountain product line refers to ProductLine = 'M'; sold by over 5 vendors refers to count(Name)>5
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT T1.ProductID FROM Product AS T1 INNER JOIN ProductVendor AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T1.ProductLine = 'M' GROUP BY T1.ProductID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.VendorID) > 2) AS t
questions.note: gold bug：官方漏 mountain 过滤（GROUP BY 全产品 HAVING>2 vendors 返 43 行 0）；改为 WHERE mountain 再计数，答案 0。

questions.question: Among the store contact employees, how many of them have a Vista credit card?
questions.evidence: store contact refers to PersonType = 'SC'; type of credit card refers to CardType; CardType = 'Vista'（注意数据为 TitleCase 'Vista'，utf8mb4_bin 大小写敏感）;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.FirstName) FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN PersonCreditCard AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN CreditCard AS T3 ON T2.CreditCardID = T3.CreditCardID WHERE T3.CardType = 'Vista' AND T1.PersonType = 'SC'
questions.note: evidence 修正 round4：CardType 真实值 'Vista'(TitleCase)，原 evidence 小写 'vista' 误导 single-shot 照猜→0 行。

questions.question: Among the vendors that sell the product Hex Nut 5, how many of them have a good credit rating?
questions.evidence: good credit rating refers to CreditRating between 1 and 3
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.Name) FROM ProductVendor AS T1 INNER JOIN Product AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID INNER JOIN Vendor AS T3 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T3.BusinessEntityID WHERE T2.Name = 'Hex Nut 5' AND T3.CreditRating BETWEEN 1 AND 3
questions.note: gold SQL 病句：evidence「good=BETWEEN 1 AND 3」被写成 =1 AND 3(=1)；改 BETWEEN，答案仍 3（本库 Hex Nut 5 vendor 恰好都 1）。

questions.question: Calculate the average age of employee in each department and state which department has the youngest employees.
questions.evidence: Average = Divide(Sum(Substract(year(@today),year(BirthDate))),Count(BusinessEntityID) by each Department ID; youngest employee refers to Min(BirthDate);
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.Name, AVG(YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(T1.BirthDate)) FROM Employee AS T1 INNER JOIN EmployeeDepartmentHistory AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN Department AS T3 ON T2.DepartmentID = T3.DepartmentID WHERE T2.EndDate IS NULL GROUP BY T3.Name ORDER BY 2 ASC
questions.note: gold 补全：题面问「每部门平均年龄 + 哪个部门最年轻」但 gold 只返最年轻个体；改按部门分组求平均年龄、按均值升序(最年轻在前)，答案 16 行。

questions.question: Calculate the average length of employment for employee working in the Research and Development deparment.
questions.evidence: average length of employment = AVG(subtract(当前年份, year(HireDate)))
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.HireDate)) FROM Employee AS T1 INNER JOIN EmployeeDepartmentHistory AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN Department AS T3 ON T2.DepartmentID = T3.DepartmentID WHERE T3.Name = 'Research and Development'

questions.question: Calculate the average of the total ordered quantity of products purchased whose shipping method was Cargo Transport 5.
questions.evidence: shipping method was Cargo Transport 5 refers to Name = 'CARGO TRANSPORT 5'; average = DIVIDE(SUM(OrderQty where Name = 'CARGO TRANSPORT 5'), COUNT(ShipMethodID))；注意：average = SUM(OrderQty)/COUNT(所有行) 的加权平均，不是 AVG(OrderQty)
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.ShipMethodID = 5, T3.OrderQty, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T3.ProductID) FROM ShipMethod AS T1 INNER JOIN PurchaseOrderHeader AS T2 ON T1.ShipMethodID = T2.ShipMethodID INNER JOIN PurchaseOrderDetail AS T3 ON T2.PurchaseOrderID = T3.PurchaseOrderID
questions.note: evidence 修正 round4：真实值 'CARGO TRANSPORT 5'(全大写)，原 evidence 混合大小写误导。

questions.question: Has the product Chainring Bolts been on any of the sales?
questions.evidence: a product that has been on sale refers to 有促销记录（special offer 表 spcl_offr），不是 SellStartDate NOT null
questions.SQL: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(T1.Description) >= 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM SpecialOffer AS T1 INNER JOIN SpecialOfferProduct AS T2 ON T1.SpecialOfferID = T2.SpecialOfferID INNER JOIN Product AS T3 ON T2.ProductID = T3.ProductID WHERE T3.Name = 'Chainring Bolts'

questions.question: How many departments did Sheela Word work in between 1/1/2011 to 12/31/2012
questions.evidence: worked between 2011 and 2012 refers to the employment period overlapping with 2011-2012 (StartDate <= '2012-12-31' AND (EndDate IS NULL OR EndDate >= '2011-01-01'));
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.DepartmentID) FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN EmployeeDepartmentHistory AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID WHERE T1.FirstName = 'Sheela' AND T1.LastName = 'Word' AND T2.StartDate <= '2012-12-31' AND (T2.EndDate IS NULL OR T2.EndDate >= '2011-01-01')
questions.note: gold bug：误用 Department.ModifiedDate(全 2008) 过滤，应改用员工任期 emp_dept_hist.StartDate/EndDate 与 2011-2012 重叠；答案 0→3。题面 Sheela Ward 实为数据 Sheela Word。

questions.question: How many departments have David Bradley been in?

questions.question: Based on the latest payrate of each employee, calculate the average hourly payrate for each department.

questions.question: List all components (direct and nested) needed to assemble 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58', along with their level in the assembly hierarchy.
questions.SQL: WITH RECURSIVE bom(ComponentID, level) AS (SELECT ComponentID, 1 FROM BillOfMaterials WHERE ProductAssemblyID=(SELECT ProductID FROM Product WHERE Name='HL Road Frame - Black, 58') AND EndDate IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.ComponentID, bom.level+1 FROM BillOfMaterials b JOIN bom ON b.ProductAssemblyID=bom.ComponentID WHERE b.EndDate IS NULL) SELECT DISTINCT p.Name, bom.level FROM bom JOIN Product p ON p.ProductID=bom.ComponentID ORDER BY bom.level, p.Name
questions.note: 官方 gold 未过滤 EndDate，把 199 条历史 BOM 行也算了进来(28 行)。题面 'needed to assemble' 应只含当前装配(EndDate IS NULL)，已补 end_dt/EndDate IS NULL，gold 从 28 行收敛到 24 行。；官方 gold 无 DISTINCT，递归会产出重复行(如 'Paint - Black' 在 level 1 两条 BOM 记录)。'list all components' 应去重，已加 SELECT DISTINCT，gold 24→23 行。

questions.note: 自拟 gold 未过滤 EndDate，含 199 条历史 BOM 行(28 行)；已补 end_dt/EndDate IS NULL，gold 28→24 行。
